title: CE31306: Environmental Impact Assessment And Auditing
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Technical and procedural aspects of Environmental Impact assessment, Guidelines
and legal aspects of environmental protection, General Framework for
characterising environmental dislocation/disruption due to pollution, Theory
and application of mathematical models:- Mathematical modeling for water
quality systems, Stream and Estuarine models for pollution control, Socioeconomic aspects, Measures of effectiveness of pollution control activities,
Inter-sector pollutant transfers, total impact assessment.
